semantics.RMS: sqrt(integral((wrapped adjacent roll rate squared + pitch rate squared)/2 *dt)/T); rad/s, NOT RMS/T
semantics.units: seconds, radians, radians/second, metres; raw source signs retained
semantics.success_priority: B alone completed the whole task in these three runs; lower partial-window RMS does not qualify PPO as better overall.
semantics.trajectory_claim: Equal event times do not prove equal complete trajectories; no raw full-trajectory comparison performed.
semantics.limitations: One run per mode; matched environment/configuration but not statistical success rates. AABB separation is a lower bound, not exact mesh clearance; collider z is not base z; CoM is not support; wheel motion does not prove traction.
